current_episode.title: Building Futures: Tec Centro's Workforce Impact with Robert Torres

guest.bio_context: Robert Torres leads TechCentro's operations in Midtown Harrisburg, a bilingual workforce development center modeled after Lancaster's successful centers that have operated for more than 10 years. He oversees adult basic education, occupational training, allied health careers, and skilled trades programs, and is preparing to launch the first construction trades classes in facilities maintenance.

context.real_quote: I want people to understand how to problem solve, the critical thinking behind problem solving. That to me would be someone attractive to hire.
key_stats: Lancaster TechCentro centers have been operating for more than 10 years
TechCentro has served people from over 20 different countries since starting a little over a year ago
Facilities maintenance class will run 8 to 12 weeks, Monday through Friday, for about 5-6 months
Average class size is about 10 students per session
Harrisburg has a poverty rate much higher than the state average
Math and reading assessments will take 15 to 30 minutes
entities: United Way of the Capital Region
